name: Toutiorix

attributes.attribute: Continental Celtic god known from one inscription
ancestral god of the tribe, similar to Teutates
identified by the Romans with Apollo

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Toutiorix was a god of the Continental Celts. He is recorded on a single inscription. He may have been an ancestral god of the tribe. In this he resembles Teutates, the tribal god of Gaul. The Romans linked Toutiorix with Apollo, their god of Healing and of the sun. Everything known about him comes from that one stone.

okr.objective: Record the Continental Celtic god Toutiorix from his single source.
